channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Fourth of July weekend brings elevated crash risk as impaired driving deaths spike 44 percent
item.description: Last Fourth of July, 579 people died in car crashes nationwide with nearly 4 in 10 deaths involving impaired driving. Local residents say they plan to use rideshares and designated drivers for holiday celebrations.

item.title: Lantana veteran gets roof lien removed after months of frustration with Boynton Beach contractor
item.description: Stephen McCoy, a disabled and retired veteran, had a nearly $7,000 lien removed from his Lantana home after a contractor failed to pay suppliers.

item.title: Florida manufactured home owners can now apply for storm-hardening and repair funding starting in August
item.description: Manufactured home owners in Martin, St. Lucie, Indian River and Okeechobee counties can access $167 million in state funding for emergency repairs and storm-hardening retrofits under a new law that took effect Wednesday.

item.title: Jensen Beach teenager Harper Aberman to represent Team USA at Sailing World Championship in France
item.description: A Jensen Beach teenager will represent Team USA at the Sailing World Championship in France this weekend, following a sailing journey that started at a Pennsylvania summer camp when she was four years old. item.title: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach offers sea turtle nesting programs through September
item.description: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach is offering educational and interactive programs during peak sea turtle nesting season this summer.

item.title: Florida Attorney General Ashley Moody marks first anniversary of Working Families Tax Cut benefitting state residents
item.description: Florida Attorney General Ashley Moody is touting the one-year anniversary of the Working Families Tax Cut Act, which eliminated federal taxes on Social Security, tips for service workers, and overtime pay.

item.title: Port St. Lucie driver held teens at gunpoint after they shot Orbeez pellets at his car, police say
item.description: A driver in Port St. Lucie held teenagers at gunpoint after they shot Orbeez pellets at his vehicle, according to police.

item.title: Sebastian Inlet State Park to get new artificial reef
item.description: A new artificial reef is coming to Sebastian Inlet State Park in Indian River County.
